title: Laura Plantation

services.name: Black Union Soldiers Tour
services.desc: Delve into the fascinating history of nine formerly enslaved men who bravely fought for their freedom during the Civil War as Union Soldiers. This 50-minute guided tour immerses you in true stories from history that happened at Laura Plantation while guiding you throughout the property. - 50-minute guided outdoor tour focusing on nine enslaved men who fought for freedom as Union Soldiers. - Explore the plantation grounds, including the authentic 1840s slave cabins - Tour does NOT go through the main house. - Learn about the impact of slavery and the Civil War in Louisiana - Visit the self-guided exhibit either before or after your tour for further insights into the lives of the enslaved

blurb: "Laura Plantation preserves and interprets the documented histories of the people who lived and labored here, illuminating the complexities of Louisiana's Creole world, the realities of enslavement, and the enduring struggle for freedom.
